result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations relating quotients of products of alternating determinant sums $\sum \pm y_1^1 y_2^2\cdots$ to quotients of products of theta functions with arguments $u_p-u_{p+1}-u_1-\dots-u_{p-1}$, together with linear-equation and determinant manipulations and tables of binary triples (characteristics).
